unitTitle: A week in my life: connect the details
title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 1: A week in my life: connect the details

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Try each phrase before reading its meaning. Choose one that is true for you, then change the day, time or activity so it describes your own week.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: D'habitude, je commence tôt, mais je termine tard.
steps.en: I usually start early, but I finish late.
steps.tip: Say it: dah-bee-TÜD zhuh koh-MAH(N)S TOH meh zhuh tehr-MEEN TAHR

steps.fr: Chaque matin, je vérifie mon horaire.
steps.en: Every morning, I check my schedule.
steps.tip: Say it: shahk mah-TA(N) zhuh vay-ree-FEE moh(n) oh-REHR

steps.fr: En général, je révise après le travail.
steps.tip: Say it: ah(n) zhay-nay-RAHL zhuh ray-VEEZ ah-preh luh trah-VAHY

steps.fr: J'ai une journée chargée parce que j'ai un atelier.
steps.en: I have a busy day because I have a workshop.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay ün zhoor-NAY shar-ZHAY parsk zh-ay uh(n) ah-tuh-LYAY

steps.fr: Je suis fatigué, donc je prends une pause.
steps.en: I am tired, so I take a break.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh swee fah-tee-GAY dohnk zhuh prah(n) ün pohz

steps.fr: D'abord, je termine ma tâche; ensuite, je me repose.
steps.en: First, I finish my task; then I rest.
steps.tip: Say it: dah-BOR zhuh tehr-MEEN mah tahsh; ah(n)-SWHEET zhuh muh ruh-POHZ

steps.fr: Si j'ai bien compris, la séance est jeudi.
steps.en: If I understood correctly, the session is Thursday.
steps.tip: Say it: see zhay byah(n) kohn-PREE lah say-AH(N)S eh zhuh-DEE

steps.fr: Tu peux préciser l'heure, s'il te plaît ?
steps.en: Can you clarify the time, please?
steps.tip: Say it: tü puh pray-see-ZAY luhr seel tuh pleh

steps.fr: Je veux dire mardi, pas mercredi.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh vuh DEER mahr-DEE pah mehr-kruh-DEE

steps.fr: Ça dépend de mon horaire; je te confirme ce soir.
steps.en: It depends on my schedule; I'll confirm tonight.
steps.tip: Say it: sah day-pah(n) duh moh(n) oh-REHR zhuh tuh kohn-FEERM suh swahr
